subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: Scan an advert to find information quickly.
Decide if statements are Yes, No or Doesn't say.

tf.s: The advert is for Treetops Adventure Playground.
The climbing wall is 15 metres high.
A ten-year-old can play in the Tiny-Tots Playground.
tf.why: It is for children aged six or under.

tf.s: You wear a helmet and a special harness for the high activities.
The Treetops guides help you put on your harness.
The special offer is three tickets for the price of one.
tf.why: It is two tickets for the price of one.

tf.s: The ice cream shop has made its own ice cream since 2014.
tf.why: It has made its own ice cream since 2004.

tf.s: Adverts use imperatives like Ride, Climb and Jump.
tf.why: Imperatives speak directly to the reader.

tf.s: In the maze, you try to find the exit.
tf.why: Yes, you go along paths and through tunnels.

tf.s: You can only buy tickets at the playground gate.
tf.why: You can buy them on the website or by phone.

boxes.q: How high is the climbing wall?
Who is the Tiny-Tots Playground for?

o: two tickets for the price of one

boxes.q: What do you wear on the high activities?
Who helps you put on your harness?

boxes.why: Imperatives give an order or invitation.

boxes.q: Which number can you phone for tickets?
Since when has the shop made its own ice cream?
What do you go through in the maze?
boxes.why: The maze has paths and tunnels.

hunt.q: Special offer: 2 for the price of…
You wear it on your head
You find the exit in the…

mcq.q: What is the adventure playground called?

o: On the website or by phoning
mcq.why: The advert gives a website and phone number.

mcq.q: What can you do in the Treetops Maze?
o: Go along the paths and through the tunnels to find the exit
mcq.why: A maze is a puzzle of paths.

mcq.q: Which word means a set of straps that keeps you safe up high?
Y, N or DS? If you're ten, you can play in the Tiny-Tots Playground.
mcq.why: It is for children six or under, so the answer is No.

mcq.q: Write a complete answer: What is the special offer?
o: The special offer is two tickets for the price of one.
mcq.why: A full sentence repeats the question words.

mcq.q: Which pair are imperatives from the advert?
Why does the advert say It's the best ice cream in the world!?
o: To make people want to visit
mcq.why: Adverts use strong words to persuade.

mcq.q: Why do adverts ask questions and use imperatives?
o: They speak directly to the reader and make the place sound exciting.
They tell a story about the past.

mcq.q: Correct this: The café has made its own ice cream since 2014.
o: The ice cream shop has made its own ice cream since 2004.
The café has made its own ice cream for 2014.
The café made ice cream in 2014.
The ice cream shop has made coffee since 2004.
mcq.why: Check the place and the year in the advert.
